prompt: Vertical 9:16 night photograph on 35 mm colour film, Kodak-style negative grain, gentle halation around the highlights, an ordinary press photographer's frame, not glossy. Tight medium close-up from slightly farther back on a long 85 mm lens, compressing the cabin of a big black chauffeur-driven car: a heavily overweight upper-class English minister around sixty leans his huge bulk toward the door, head tilted in to the phone he holds to his right ear with his right hand, his head and shoulders filling the upper half of the frame. A great tangled mop of pale white-blond hair, uncombed, flops forward over his brow and one eye. His face: a long, fleshy hooked nose with burst red veins, heavy-lidded narrow blue eyes glancing sideways, thin lips curled into a sly half-smile as he murmurs a word, pendulous jowls, a broad pale freckled complexion with blotchy cheeks. Rumpled navy chalk-stripe suit, a crumpled maroon and gold club tie hanging loose, a heavy signet ring on his right little finger pressed against the phone. On the leather armrest a small round silver tray of canapés, little pastry tartlets and quail eggs. Light: a warm yellow overhead reading lamp glows on the top of his messy hair, leaving his eyes in half-shadow; the phone's pale glow lights his ear and fingers; through the rain-beaded window behind him cold blue emergency lights pulse and smear, painting a hard blue rim along his jaw, with distant sodium-orange street lamps defocused into blobs. Real skin texture, natural hands with the right number of fingers. No readable text anywhere. Thanks.
